name: car_sedan_787b
source: Owner request 2026-09-26: a copy of the sedan with a Mazda 787B-style driveline, for the driveline shuffle after a throttle lift-off. Everything not listed here is copied unchanged from tests/support/fixtures/vehicles/car_sedan_rwd.json (the 787B is rear-wheel drive, Wikipedia 'Mazda 787B', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mazda_787B): wheel geometry, suspension (sized there for 1500 kg), tyres (data/tyres/passenger_car_225_45r17.json - not the 787B's Dunlop slicks), steering, brakes, aero drag area, clutch engagement curve and out_inertia, differential ratio/efficiency/carrier inertia - see that file's source field. The chassis mass is not part of this file: the real 787B weighs 830 kg (Wikipedia, same page), the Godot demo (adapters/godot/demo/scripts/main.gd) builds 1500 kg. DIFFERENCES: (1) ENGINE data/engines/r26b_4rotor.json (Mazda R26B, cited there). (2) GEARBOX: data/gearboxes/sedan_6mt.json is REUSED - the 787B used a Mazda/Porsche 5-speed manual (Wikipedia), but no citable source for its ratios was found; final drive 4.06 likewise reused. (3) CLUTCH capacity_nm 1200 = about 2x the cited 608 N*m peak engine torque (assumed sizing, no cited clutch capacity; the sedan's 300 N*m is below this engine's torque). (4) COMPLIANT SHAFTS (compliance 'compliant', PHYS-033 P4 I4 C13), steel shear modulus G = 79.3 GPa (Wikipedia 'Shear modulus' table), solid round shaft polar moment J_p = pi*d^4/32, stiffness k = G*J_p/L. Shaft DIMENSIONS ARE ASSUMED, not cited. (4a) clutch.out-gearbox.in = gearbox input shaft, assumed d 30 mm, L 0.30 m: J_p = 7.952e-8 m^4, k = 79.3e9*7.952e-8/0.30 = 21020 N*m/rad (a race multi-plate clutch is modelled without damper springs, so this shaft is the only compliance there). Damping c = 2*zeta*sqrt(k*J_red) with an ASSUMED zeta 0.05 and J_red = 0.064*0.010/0.074 = 0.00865 kg*m^2 (engine 0.06 + clutch.out 0.004 against gearbox.in 0.010): c = 1.35 N*m*s/rad. (4b) HALFSHAFTS: assumed solid d 30 mm, effective length 0.50 m (less than half the cited rear track, 1534/2 = 767 mm): k_hs = 79.3e9*7.952e-8/0.50 = 12612 N*m/rad each. C13 does not allow a compliant diff.left-wheel or diff.right-wheel shaft (a differential's output ports have zero inertia and DifferentialDesc has no output-inertia field; a ratio-1 gear_pair to add one would put a rigid row on the outputs of this lossy (0.97) diff, which the graph builder rejects). The two halfshafts are therefore LUMPED into one equivalent spring on gearbox.out-diff.carrier (the 787B is a mid-engine transaxle car, no propshaft there): in the in-phase (shuffle) mode both halfshafts act in parallel, 2*k_hs at the wheels, referred through the final drive k_eq = 2*12612/4.06^2 = 1530.3 N*m/rad. What the lumping changes: it drops the antisymmetric left/right halfshaft mode and moves the carrier inertia (0.02 kg*m^2, 0.33 kg*m^2 at the wheels) from the engine side of the spring to the wheel side. Damping per halfshaft from an ASSUMED zeta 0.05 against one wheel (0.905 kg*m^2): c_hs = 2*0.05*sqrt(12612*0.905) = 10.68 N*m*s/rad, referred c_eq = 2*10.68/4.06^2 = 1.30 N*m*s/rad. (5) CONTROLLERS: car_sedan_rwd's rpm thresholds scaled to this engine - auto_clutch by the idle ratio 1500/800 = 1.875 (bite 1100 -> 2060, full_rpm_min 1600 -> 3000, full_rpm_max 3000 -> 5600, anti_stall 750 -> 1400, rolling_reengage default 1300 -> 2440), auto_shift by the limiter ratio 9000/6800 = 1.32 (up 2500/6300 -> 3300/8350, down 1300/2800 -> 1720/3700); rates/times unchanged.
